findings.passage: This bill will prove to be critical in expanding voting access across the Commonwealth by making several COVID-era voting provisions permanent, including expansions to early voting, vote-by-mail, and absentee ballot access.
findings.note: Statement in his press release on the Senate passing S.2545, the VOTES Act. He describes permanent no-excuse mail voting and same-day registration. The release does not mention ID requirements. Date taken from the page URL.
subjects: mail ballot access (related, no ID mentioned)

findings.passage: This legislation will not only help to ensure the integrity of our elections, but also help to expand voting opportunities by making the process more fair and accessible for all.
findings.note: His quote on a Senate-passed automatic voter registration bill he co-sponsored. The bill title includes enhancing safeguards against fraud and it raises penalties for false information. No ID or citizenship document requirement is described. Date taken from the page URL.
